_comment: Percentage of ONE PORT's capacity consumed by ONE panel (Adam, 2026-08-25). Per PORT, not per processor - a port is full at 100%, so maxPanelsPerPort = floor(100 / pct). Shape: table[processor][family][size][refreshHz][bitDepth].
_doNotTidy: The MX30 has NO 12bit column - it is 8/10bit only. Omitting the key is what disables 12bit for the MX30.
Uniview figures are IDENTICAL on MX30 and MX40.
Chauvet REM costs noticeably more on the MX30 (8% vs 5% at 60hz/8bit for a 1000x500). That is real and is NOT explained by pixel bandwidth alone - authoritative lookup data, not something to compute.
Uniview 500x500 @ 60hz/8bit is 6%. An early spreadsheet said 3%; that was wrong (below the 50hz figure, and not half the 1000x500). Both tables agree on 6%.
